data: You lash out with an incredible fang attack. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On critical hits, instead of doubling the dice, you can choose to do damage equal to half the target’s current HP (up to a maximum of 5x your level)..
Badly startles all Pokémon that successfully showed their appeal.
All Pokemon that succeeded the Judge DC and gained appeal points must make CHA Saving Throws against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
